Description
: This unique collectible lot features a selection of vintage cigar boxes, a retro Lucky Ten cigarette advertisement, and a brown ceramic smoking pipe. The cigar boxes include brands such as White Owl Brand, H. Upmann, La Palina, and Primo Del Rey, some with ornate and colorful internal and external graphics, showing typical wear and patina that enhances their vintage appeal. The Lucky Ten ad highlights a period piece of tobacco history, promoting their low 'tar' filtered cigarettes, perfect for display or historical collections. The brown ceramic pipe, marked 'National Potteries Co. Made in Japan,' features a glossy finish with gold detailing and an integrated rest, ideal as a decorative accent or conversation piece. All items display visible vintage character, with the boxes showing age-related signs and the pipe appearing intact with minor wear. Great for collectors, display, or vintage decor, this lot provides a snapshot into tobacco memorabilia and midcentury design

Geological Rock & Mineral Specimen Lot
Set of 4 Specimens
Sealed Plastic Display Cases
This collection features four distinct geological rock and mineral specimens, each preserved in an individual factory-sealed clear plastic display dome with black foam mounting. The assortment includes diverse geological formations, highlighted by a porous red volcanic scoria sample and a fibrous pale mineral specimen, ideal for earth science study or display.
Four unique raw geological specimens with varied textures and colors
Specimens mounted on black foam within clear plastic display domes
Factory-sealed protective blister cases designed for viewing and study
Condition:
All four specimens remain factory sealed within their original plastic display cases. The plastic packaging shows light exterior surface scuffs, scratches, and dust from storage, with the cases remaining structurally intact and fully sealed. Specimens inside are undisturbed and well preserved.

283792671.description:
Viva Bohemia
Karlovy Vary Spa Cup Mineral Water Sipper
Porcelain, Cobalt Blue, Vintage
Traditional Czech spa drinking cup (lazensky poharek) designed for sipping thermal mineral waters in the historic spa town of Karlovy Vary (Carlsbad). Featuring an ergonomic hollow handle that functions as an integrated drinking straw, this piece showcases a rich cobalt blue glaze accented with delicate floral sprays, gilded accents, and geometric border patterning.
Integrated drinking spout extending through the handle for thermal spring waters
Deep cobalt blue porcelain with multi-colored floral bouquet and script Karlovy Vary lettering
Fully marked on underside with circular fountain logo reading Karlsbad Karlovy Vary Carlsbad Original Viva Bohemia
Measures approximately 5 inches by 5 inches
Condition:
Decoration fully intact with crisp script and vibrant floral details. Free of chips, cracks, crazing, or fleabites along the rim, base, and spout opening. Glossy glaze finish preserved throughout with only minor shelf wear to the unglazed foot pads.
